title: BACKND Base guild
summary: Guild system (CreateGuildV4 and related): create and join guilds, search guilds and members, manage guild metadata and goods (with reset-time rules), guild-master role grants, and operator actions (approve/refuse join, banish). Guilds carry goods count and optional country code.
capabilities: route guild create/join/search/management questions to the right sub-family
distinguish member, guild-master, and operator capabilities
explain guild goods and reset-time-restricted operations
relate guild ranking to the leaderboard guild family
prerequisites: SDK is initialized and the user is logged in
Guild settings (goods count, country code) are decided at creation
common_pitfalls: Trying to change goodsCount after creation (fixed at create time)
Calling master/operator actions without the required role
Ignoring reset-time restrictions on goods/metadata changes
Confusing guild ranking with the leaderboard guild family
verification_required_for: exact method names and CreateGuildV4 overloads
verification_strategy: Use https://docs.backnd.com plus the narrower source route before generating guild code.
Confirm role requirements and reset-time rules from the official pages.
public_notes: Guild has distinct member, guild-master, and operator capability tiers.
Guild ranking is served by the leaderboard guild family, not the guild topic.
